entries.note: Independent audit 2026-11-23 of all 6 keys of wire.ask_receipts in ru against en source 1ae74bc10135dee17828f58af819fc521bd1e15024b3ce466cca20e49e102507 and sidecar 48222d4c8f3d776444973f6e4b1bfc5052552dada49708c06c7faa0e53e78dfa; target c0b74f7a99fd2a0f941df20c2b41a38b14457ab86b0d40a7f970183389b5819c recomputed from the file after the audit edits. Method: read docs/I18N.md, glossary, the locale style guide and the sidecar; compared with the shipped relay.ask / relay.asks sibling renderings of the same states; rendered every key with local_operator.i18n.messages.render for surface remote/tui/chat/desktop/other x reason answered_in_chat/moot/absent/unknown and waited 45s/3h/42m; checked placeholder and ICU select arm parity, NFC, no manual bidi controls, no English word inside a translated sentence, and cell widths against maxCells. No catalogue edits. Inherited from the English label and matched by the shipped relay.asks vocabulary, so kept; context sidecar and the card name the real meaning beside it. Evidence is this auditor's own command output in the lane session, not an external report.
